en.headline: Rainstorm Warning Signal (Red)
en.description:
The Red Rainstorm Warning Signal was issued at 8:02 a.m.

Heavy rain has fallen or is expected to fall generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 50 millimetres in an hour.
